1284-4687-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least four counters on it.
1284-4687-4929.description:
Activate Viridian Longbow by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Cryptic Trilobite, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-2403-4050--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake ability, gaining at least 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1856-6249-8095--5.easyPrerequisites: Doom Weaver paired with the persist creature.
1856-6249-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Doom Weaver trigger.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Doom Weaver and Olivia trigger.
Resolve the Doom Weaver ability, pairing it with the persist creature.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from the persist creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

3755-4222-8039.description:
Activate Spireside Infiltrator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Spireside Infiltrator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Spireside Infiltrator.
Repeat.

252-3480-4231-5394.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-3480-4231-5394.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

4629-7839.description:
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each player and creature.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

206-3755-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
206-3755-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
206-3755-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1368-4289-5295-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4289-5295-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2872-5434-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

5147-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3334-3899-4552-7280.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Donatello
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-5419-6751.description:
Activate Kalain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kalain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Kalain.
Resolve both Kalain triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

2100-7117.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {0} due to Aang's cost reduction, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Repeat.

5147-5671-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

57-283-1849-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-1849-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

851-2457-4289-7060.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3918-4222-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
3918-4222-6788.description:
Activate Trazyn using Solar Array's ability by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
3918-4222-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

1976-4013-4659-5004-6643.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

3129-5658-6245-6753.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
3129-5658-6245-6753.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
3129-5658-6245-6753.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

2511-4659-5003-6644.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Treasures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2187-3603-5195.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Possessed Skaab
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Possessed Skaab
When Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

586-2510-3967-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
586-2510-3967-5258-5618.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3859-5674-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least {E} or enough mana to cast Cavern Harpy
3859-5674-5870.description:
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers, if able, or by paying its mana cost.
When Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, it and Guide of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to get {E} and gain 1 life.
Resolve the Cavern Harpy trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

513-1031-2103.description:
Cast Invasion of Arcavios by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning up to one nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand, or searching your library for Capture of Jingzhou and putting it into your hand, if needed.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Invasion of Arcavios to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

134-313-1170-1749-4113.description:
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by tapping Caetus, Vampire Hexmage and two other creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Caetus and causing it to return to the battlefield as Invasion of Segovia.
When Invasion of Segovia enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Kraken creature tokens.
Activate Vampire Hexmage by sacrificing it, removing all counters from Invasion of Segovia.
Invasion of Segovia triggers, causing you to exile it and cast it as Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia.
Resolve Corpse Dance, returning Vampire Hexmage from your graveyard to the battlefield and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat.

643-1636-4117-4338.notablePrerequisites: Visara does not have summoning sickness.
643-1636-4117-4338.description:
Activate Visara by tapping it, destroying any creature you control.
The creature dies, triggering Rotlung Reanimator, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
The Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

507-672.description:
Any time a player would cast a spell, Possibility Storm exiles that spell and reveals cards until you find one they could cast.
Eidolon of Rhetoric prevents them from casting a second spell resulting in a lock.

1564-1953-2105.description:
Cast Tempt with Reflections by paying {3}{U}, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare one of the Combat Celebrant copy as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2334-2556-4377.description:
With Soulherder and a creature based spell recursion effect on the battlefield, cast the extra turn spell.
Move to end step and target the creature with Soulherder's ability.
When creature re-enters the battlefield, target the extra turn spell in your graveyard and return it to your hand, then pass to yourself.
Repeat
